changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE Name = N'ScoreType' AND Object_ID = Object_ID(N'metrics.asset')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE metrics.asset ADD ScoreType [int] not null default(1) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE Name = N'ScoreType' AND Object_ID = Object_ID(N'metrics.asset')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE metrics.asset DROP COLUMN ScoreType END
